sources.note: Main homepage listing all products/modules (EHR, PM, RCM, eRx, eLabs, eForms, PACS, Patient Kiosk, Patient Portal, Command Center, Smart Phone Apps, Bar Coding, Practice Building, eAppts Reminders). Usage stats: 20M patient visits, 47M prescriptions, 125M clinical documents. Founded 1994, Lawrenceville GA.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Pricing model: per-provider/concurrent logins/locations. Mentions data export charges, HL7 interface fees, maintenance fees. Links to API docs, B10 export documentation, privacy policy.
EHR product page. Real-time electronic charting, touchscreen design for iPad and Surface tablets. Cloud and server-based deployment options. Lists all integrated modules.

Practice Management page. Scheduling (multi-provider/multi-location), automated charge entry from EHR, 98% clean claim rate, electronic claim submission, automatic EOB posting, eligibility verification, appointment reminders (text/voice/email), electronic statements.
eRx module page. Electronic prescribing, pharmacy routing, refill request processing, drug-allergy and drug-drug interaction alerts. Does not mention EPCS or Surescripts by name.
eLabs module page. Bi-directional lab interfaces with national/regional/local labs. Results in electronic and PDF format. Abnormal result highlighting, lab value trend tracking with graphs.

Command Center page. Clinic workflow automation from patient arrival to departure. Schematic clinic view showing patient locations/status. Automated ancillary service orders (x-rays, EKGs, audiology, blood work).

Smartphone app page. Provider 24/7 access to patient records, lab/test results, progress notes. Electronic messaging with team, remote prescription refill review, clinical photo capture (pre/intra/post-operative), remote sign-off on clinical items.
V8.0 announcement. Touchscreen-first redesign, real-time documentation, specialty-specific knowledgebases for 25+ specialties, elimination of dropdown pick lists.

PM integration article. Describes automated charge capture from EHR to PM, streamlined scheduling/eligibility/claims workflow, unified financial and clinical dashboards. Claims 40% admin reduction, 35% billing efficiency increase.
EHR-billing integration article. CPT/DX codes auto-flow from clinical documentation to PM. Multiple daily claim submissions. Clearinghouse partnerships. Eliminates paper charge tickets.
Specialty support article. 25+ medical and surgical specialties with customizable clinical documentation. No specific specialties listed — emphasizes platform flexibility.
Target market article. Focus on physician-owned independent practices. Differentiates from hospital system solutions. Mentions patient portal for secure communication.
CEO message from Thomas J. Bierster, Jr. Founded 1994. Record sales in 2018. Claims physicians generate $100K-$500K additional revenue using MD Logic. International division expanding.

Third-party listing. Pricing: $199-$499/provider/month. Specialties mentioned: orthopedics, podiatry, otolaryngology. Strengths: easy interface, organized records, fast documentation. Weaknesses: basic customization, complex setup, limited advanced specialty features. No user reviews available.
